law: A tap must open the word the text means. In kana-only text UniDic sometimes splits or names the wrong word, and the reader and the decks look a word up by its base, so a wrong split opens a wrong entry. This lexicon re-splits those runs at tokenization time (build_corridor.tokenise, before the reading lexicon), so every consumer of tokenise() — the shelf, feed and archive mints, build_examples, the 言葉の鉱脈 decks — gets the same split. It never changes the text: each entry's tokens spell exactly what it matched.

provenance.authored: 2026-10-06, the player-bugs pass after #121, from the library curator's kanji screen (docs/content/library-candidates-2026-10-03: こうばん, まどの, ぶちょう) and the deck handoff's open item (docs/srs/HANDOFF_2026-10-04.md, what remains: なん in 〜なんで tagged as the pronoun).
provenance.policy: Match adjacent token surfaces exactly; a match row may also name the POS (p) or the base (b) UniDic gave, and `after` may guard the token before the run, so an entry fires only on the mistake it was written for. A replacement token's base (b) is the dictionary headword the reader should open (交番, not こうばん, which is also 降板). Every entry has a sentence fixture in prototypes/corridor/tools/test_segment_overrides.py.

entries.note: UniDic reads kana こうばん as the adverb こう + 晩. Found by the library curator (bunki-orig-n4-police-box-note was written with 交番 in kanji to avoid it).
UniDic reads kana まどの as the interjection ま + どの. Guarded on the interjection, so いまどの (今どの) is untouched.
UniDic keeps the surface but names 不調 (ふちょう), so a tap opened 不調. Kana ぶちょう is 部長.

entries.word: 〜ずなんで (copula な + ん + で)
entries.note: After ず (相変わらずなんで) UniDic tags なん as the pronoun 何, so a tap opened 何. It is the explanatory な + ん + で, split the way UniDic itself splits 暇なんで. Guarded on ず: a sentence-initial なんで (why) stays 何.
